ontology.name: Electric Range / Oven (candidate)
ontology.description: CG-10 candidate functional diagnostic ontology for electric range/oven appliances. NOT frozen. No component earns canonical status from this skeleton; R1–R3 manual evidence required before any rev1 freeze.
ontology.candidateNote: Functional hypothesis only — manuals may delete, merge, split, or reject these concepts. Physical part counts (4 burners, bake+broil elements) must not drive ontology shape.

designPrinciples: Model functional heating, control, feedback, safety, and user-command behavior — not burner count or element part topology.

Separate power, control, UI, oven heat generation, surface heat generation, temperature feedback, cavity environment, convection, door state, thermal protection, and electronics cooling diagnostically.
Bake/broil/convection may be instances of one oven heating function or genuinely distinct diagnostic functions — R1–R3 must decide.
Surface radiant elements, bridge elements, infinite switches, and warming zones may collapse to surface_heating_system or require finer decomposition — evidence decides.
Gas igniter/valve, induction power modules, and DSI boards are out of CG-10 electric scope — reserved for CG-11+ fit tests.
Manufacturer-specific naming (ACU, Copernicus, LCX, Ceran, RTD) belongs in overlays — not canonical expansion by default.
Nothing in this file modifies frontend/components/diagnostics/knowledge/canonical/ — calibration artifact only.
